In BroadcastSummary.tsx: `{canMoveToDraft && (
    <LemonButton
        type="secondary"
        size="small"
        onClick={moveToDraft}
        loading={movingToDraft}
        data-attr="broadcast-move-to-draft"
    >
        Move to draft
    </LemonButton>
)}` and in broadcastWizardLogic.ts: `const updated = await hogFlowsPartialUpdate(projectId, broadcastId, { status: 'draft' })
actions.saveBroadcastFinished(updated)
actions.hydrateFromBroadcast(updated)` together with `isReadOnly: [
    (s) => [s.broadcast],
    (broadcast: HogFlowApi | null): boolean => !!broadcast && broadcast.status !== 'draft',
]`.

In broadcastWizardLogic.ts: `canMoveToDraft: [
    (s) => [s.broadcast, s.batchJobs, s.batchJobsLoading],
    (broadcast: HogFlowApi | null, batchJobs: HogFlowBatchJobApi[], batchJobsLoading: boolean): boolean =>
        !batchJobsLoading && broadcast?.status === 'active' && batchJobs.length === 0,
]` and in BroadcastSummary.tsx: `{canMoveToDraft && (
    <LemonButton
        type="secondary"
        size="small"
        onClick={moveToDraft}
        loading={movingToDraft}
        data-attr="broadcast-move-to-draft"
    >
        Move to draft
    </LemonButton>
)}`.

In broadcastWizardLogic.ts: `canMoveToDraft: [
    (s) => [s.broadcast, s.batchJobs, s.batchJobsLoading],
    (broadcast: HogFlowApi | null, batchJobs: HogFlowBatchJobApi[], batchJobsLoading: boolean): boolean =>
        !batchJobsLoading && broadcast?.status === 'active' && batchJobs.length === 0,
]`. The selector does not check whether there is more than one schedule or whether the underlying workflow shape is safe for the wizard to edit.

The patch only modifies frontend files (BroadcastSummary.tsx and broadcastWizardLogic.ts) via `const updated = await hogFlowsPartialUpdate(projectId, broadcastId, { status: 'draft' })`. The backend scheduler is not included in the patch, so what is shown is not enough to tell if the scheduler re-verifies broadcast status before creating a send run.

result:
### Summary of Changes

#### 1. Ability to Move Live Scheduled Broadcasts Back to Draft
* **Problem**: Once a scheduled broadcast was launched, it transitioned to `active` status and opened in the read-only [`BroadcastSummary`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/BroadcastSummary.tsx) view. Users had no way to edit or cancel the scheduled broadcast from the Broadcasts area prior to sending.
* **Changes in [`broadcastWizardLogic.ts`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.ts)**:
  * Added the `canMoveToDraft` selector, which is `true` when a broadcast is `active`, has not yet executed any batch jobs (`batchJobs.length === 0`), and batch jobs are not currently loading.
  * Added `moveToDraft` and `moveToDraftFinished` actions and a `movingToDraft` boolean reducer to manage button loading state.
  * Added a `moveToDraft` listener that:
    1. Sends a `PATCH` request to `/api/projects/:id/hog_flows/:id/` updating `status` back to `'draft'`.
    2. Updates logic state via `saveBroadcastFinished` and `hydrateFromBroadcast`, navigating the wizard to the review step (or first invalid step).
    3. Displays a success notification (`"Broadcast moved to draft"`).
* **Changes in [`BroadcastSummary.tsx`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/BroadcastSummary.tsx)**:
  * Added a "Move to draft" button (`LemonButton`) in the top navigation bar when `canMoveToDraft` is true, invoking `moveToDraft`. Moving to draft immediately switches the scene back to the interactive wizard.

---

#### 2. Clean Schedule Replacement on Launch
* **Problem**: When a broadcast draft's audience (filters) was modified, the backend automatically paused existing schedules (`_pause_schedules_on_audience_change`). Because `status` is a read-only field in the schedules API and schedule updates preserve paused status, relaunching failed to unpause the schedule. As a result, the broadcast appeared active with a "Broadcast scheduled" confirmation but never sent.
* **Changes in [`broadcastWizardLogic.ts`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.ts)**:
  * In the `launchBroadcast` listener, before creating the new schedule (or batch job), any existing schedules for the workflow are listed via [`hogFlowsSchedulesList`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/generated/api.ts) and destroyed via [`hogFlowsSchedulesDestroy`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/generated/api.ts).
  * A fresh active schedule is then created via [`hogFlowsSchedulesCreate`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/generated/api.ts) (which defaults to `active`), and the updated broadcast is retrieved and stored so the schedule state is never stale or paused.

---

#### 3. Test Coverage
* **Created [`broadcastWizardLogic.test.ts`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/systematic-cache-setup/bench/worktrees/posthog-posthog-flash-systematic-0/products/workflows/frontend/Broadcasts/broadcastWizardLogic.test.ts)**:
  * Unit tests validating `canMoveToDraft` under different statuses and batch job conditions.
  * Unit tests verifying `moveToDraft` transitions `status` to draft, resets read-only state, navigates to review, and shows toast feedback.
  * Unit tests verifying `launchBroadcast` deletes existing stale/paused schedules and creates a fresh active schedule on relaunch.
